result.summary: Several visual and content issues found: a search placeholder typo, truncated restaurant names/labels, and clipped UI elements in horizontal lists.

issues.description: Search field placeholder has a spelling error: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line or tooltip so the full name is readable

issues.description: Category filter chips row is clipped on the right edge (partial pill visible), and the third 'Fastest near you' card is heavily cut off
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll affordance is clear (e.g. peek of next item with consistent padding) and that clipped text/images don’t look broken

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the tab bar with no clear scroll fade or spacing
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards aren’t obscured by the fixed tab bar
